short_description: Has anyone finished GTA 6 yet? Streamer N3on reportedly reached the end on stream in about 7 hours, but that claim is disputed (some posts say it was only the first chapter). A public completion tracker lists its first finisher at 21h 21m and says positions are still provisional. Reviewers who played the story report about 40-60 hours. Nothing official from Rockstar on the fastest finish. No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar gameplay.

short.headline: FINISHED IN 7 HOURS?
short.text: Has anyone finished GTA 6 yet? One streamer says he did it in seven hours.
short.text_es: ¿Alguien ya terminó GTA 6? Un streamer dice que lo hizo en siete horas.

short.headline: N3ON: 7 HOURS?
short.text: N3on reportedly reached the end on stream in about seven hours. Some posts say it was only the first chapter.
short.text_es: N3on dijo que llegó al final en unas siete horas. Otros dicen que fue solo el primer capítulo.

short.headline: TRACKER: 21 HOURS
short.text: A completion tracker lists its first finisher at twenty one hours, and calls that provisional.
short.text_es: Un rastreador público pone al primero en veintiuna horas, y dice que es provisional.

short.headline: REVIEWERS: 40-60 HOURS
short.text: Reviewers who played the story took around forty to sixty hours.
short.text_es: Los reviewers tardaron entre cuarenta y sesenta horas en la historia.
